title: Turnip and leek puff tart with eggs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Every ingredient is a plain kitchen staple: butter, leeks, crème fraîche, mustard, all-butter puff pastry, turnips, oil, cheddar and eggs.

supermarket.reason: Everything is an everyday line at Tesco, including the ready-rolled 320g puff pastry sheet.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a frying pan, a baking tray, baking paper and a grater, and slicing turnips thinly with a knife is within a beginner's reach.

works.reason: The oven temperature, timings and quantities give a sensible tart for four: thin turnip slices cook in 20 minutes at 200°C, and the eggs set in the extra 8 to 10 minutes.

honest_times.reason: Twenty-five minutes covers slicing the leeks and turnips, grating the cheese, softening the leeks and assembling, and the 30 cook minutes match the 20 plus 8 to 10 minutes of baking.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the thyme, appears in the steps, each name matches its id, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: A hot tart topped with a full layer of turnip and leeks suits early February, and the turnips are a main layer rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a satisfying lunch with two vegetables, eggs and cheese on pastry that a family would happily eat again.
